title: This Jellyfish Has 24 Eyes and No Brain, and It Still Learns
subject: box jellyfish

scenes.text: This jellyfish has no brain, but it learns from its mistakes.
It has twenty-four eyes, in four clusters of six, and it lives in murky mangrove swamps full of roots.
Each cluster has only about a thousand neurons. A human brain has about a hundred billion.
In 2023, scientists put twelve of them in a striped tank. In about seven minutes, they bumped the wall less than half as often.
Even a single eye cluster, cut off from the rest, learned to react to stripes it used to ignore.
No brain. And it still learned the lesson.

description:
A box jellyfish with no brain learned to avoid obstacles in about seven minutes.
It has 24 eyes in four clusters of about a thousand neurons each, and one cluster alone can learn.
How can an animal with no brain learn?
first_comment: A jellyfish with no brain learns. What do you think counts as thinking?
